project_type: Monorepo: LINE Bot webhook (TypeScript Lambda) + Bedrock AgentCore agents (Python 3.12) + CDK infra
build_system: pnpm workspaces, uv for Python, CDK for infra
test_framework: vitest for TypeScript (packages/functions), pytest with pytest-asyncio for Python (packages/agent/tests/)
test_command: pnpm test (runs vitest in packages/functions, pytest in packages/agent)
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm install at root, 2. Run pnpm typecheck, 3. Run pnpm test
setup_instructions: pnpm install at root; cd packages/agent && uv sync for Python deps
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no external package installs, no Docker. Use pre-installed runtimes for validation. TypeScript type-checking (tsc --noEmit) is the primary host-based validation for TS changes.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing code patterns. Use existing shared modules.
key_patterns: handler.ts dispatches commands via switch/case, calls invokeAgent with action+payload. Agent main.py dispatches actions to handler functions. print_generator/entrypoint.py has handle_generate_print that receives payload with params dict. adaptive_learning/agent.py has determine_next_problem(child_id, current_unit_order) already implemented. Children table stores current_unit_order on child records (updated by stats.py _try_unlock_next_unit). Tests use vitest mocks extensively for AWS services.
directory_structure: packages/functions/src/webhook/ - LINE webhook handler; packages/functions/src/shared/ - shared modules (agentcore, family, state, s3); packages/agent/src/ - Python agent with print_generator/, adaptive_learning/, grading/ submodules; packages/agent/tests/ - pytest tests; packages/infra/ - CDK stack definitions
